subject.title: fix(browser): use public ssrf runtime import in CDP proxy bypass

question: Should the managed-proxy CDP bypass helper stay private owner-scoped, or be promoted into the public `ssrf-runtime` SDK contract?
rationale: The bug needs a fix, but the viable repairs cross the private SSRF/proxy helper boundary differently; automation should not choose that SDK/security contract direction by itself.

options.title: Preserve private owner scope
options.body: Fix Browser/Ollama package resolution while keeping the bypass helper off the public Plugin SDK surface.

options.title: Promote public SDK helper
options.body: Expose the helper from `ssrf-runtime` only with explicit docs, guardrail updates, release-note context, and package smoke proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve private owner scope
recommendation.body: Fix Browser/Ollama package resolution while keeping the bypass helper off the public Plugin SDK surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent package-boundary history and private SDK declaration work make this the strongest available owner for the SDK/security-boundary choice.
